answer: Each new identity docks at the jetty, pays a 40-credit joining fee, and joins the registry graph as one vertex. The fee burns to ember at once, never refunded, and the burn is logged beside it for replay. A second identity from one funder pays 40+8(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 credits for a 40,000 pool. A rented vertex fails because its burn receipt is key-bound to the payer. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its vertex.
